description: Two dancers orbit sideways round the dancer beside them, looking across the set.

walkthrough.line: Look at {who} across the set and keep looking. Travel sideways round the dancer beside you.
walkthrough.teach: You are facing {who} across the set, and you keep looking at them for the whole figure. The two of you travel sideways round the dancer standing beside you, one of you passing in front of them and the other behind, and come back to your own places. Callers often call it a sideways do-si-do danced while you look across the set. Your hands stay at your sides.
